work.note: Existing survey chapter label '1929 · The Sound and the Fury' supplies the work's publication year; bibliography identifies the work. This dates publication, not its fictional setting or the lecture's creation.

description: Examines the Compson family through four narrative sections, connecting broken chronology, race, gender, loss, and the struggle to understand others. Covers Faulkner: Four Dates, Several Kinds of Time; Faulkner: Caddy, the Character Everyone Tries to Own; Faulkner: Quentin, Honor, Shame, and a Life Narrowing; Faulkner: Dilsey, Labor, Race, and the Limits of Redemption.
